Corners, endpoint derivative failures, ties and open-domain exceptions included.
varietyReview: Cubic endpoint winner, filtered quartic roots, absolute-value corner, radical endpoint, exponential product, procedure selection, complete candidate table with ties, rational values, calculator logarithm comparison, open-domain nonattainment and an endpoint-omission correction.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
